name: cavemio-wheel-picker
title: Wheel picker
description: Drums you can fling: each column is a real cylinder that decays onto a row, with a lens in full colour over the middle.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Each wheel is a spinbutton with aria-valuetext (the option and its unit). Arrow keys step, Page Up and Down jump five, Home and End go to the ends.
- A tap on a row above or below the lens turns it to the middle; the row is found from the drum's angle, not the flat offset, so rows near the rim land correctly.
- Every wheel has 18 faces whatever its length: only faces turning round the back are relabelled, so 60 minutes or 100 years cost the same. Turning writes two transforms a frame and renders nothing through React.
- The drum leaves a hole under the lens through its mask, so the lens copy is the only text there; mouse wheels over the picker turn it instead of scrolling the page.
- Reduced motion turns the wheel straight to the row instead of decaying onto it; dragging still follows the pointer.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: WheelPicker itemHeight
props.description: 36 · Row height in px (28–56). The drum's radius, the band and the text size follow from it.

props.name: WheelPicker haptics
props.description: true · A 3ms vibration per row while a finger turns a wheel, on phones that support it.

props.name: options
props.type: (T | { value: T; label?: string; disabled?: boolean })[]
props.description: – · Strings, numbers or objects. Disabled options are dimmed and the wheel turns past them.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: – · Controlled or uncontrolled. A controlled change turns the wheel to the new option.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · Called once the wheel comes to rest on a new option, not while it turns.

props.name: loop
props.description: false · Turn past the end back to the start, like minutes or months.

props.name: label
props.description: – · What the wheel sets, for screen readers: "Hours".

props.name: unit
props.description: – · Fixed beside the lens, e.g. "min", or a function for "1 hour" / "2 hours". It morphs when the value changes.

props.name: align
props.description: "center" · Where the options sit in their column.

useCases.title: Alarm and timer apps
useCases.description: Choose hours and minutes on drums.

useCases.title: Date pickers
useCases.description: Day, month and year columns that never allow an impossible date.

useCases.title: Forms with short lists
useCases.description: Quantities, sizes or durations picked by turning a wheel.

useCases.title: Mobile web settings
useCases.description: A phone-style picker where a select would look out of place.

features.title: Real drums
features.description: Options tip away toward the rim as they leave the middle, and a lens band in full colour sits over the middle row.

features.title: Flings that land
features.description: The release speed is projected forward and the wheel decays onto a row instead of snapping.

features.title: The value commits at rest
features.description: onValueChange is called once the wheel stops on a new option, not while it turns.

features.title: Options that can’t be chosen
features.description: Disabled options are dimmed and passed over, so a date picker can rule out days that do not exist.

features.title: Loops and units
features.description: Columns can loop, like minutes. A unit beside the lens morphs with the value, from “1 hour” to “2 hours”.

features.title: Keyboard and screen readers
features.description: Each wheel is a spinbutton: arrows step, Page Up and Down jump five, and Home and End go to the ends.

states.title: drag
states.description: The drum follows the pointer one row per row height. Past the ends of a wheel that doesn't loop it stretches with resistance, up to about one and a half rows.

states.title: fling
states.description: Release velocity from the last 90ms is projected 0.3s ahead and rounded to a row; the wheel decays onto it exponentially (τ 300ms, or 120ms for a short nudge), so it lands without a separate snap.

states.title: wheel and keys
states.description: A mouse notch or an arrow key moves one row (τ 110ms), Page Up and Down five. Trackpad scrolling turns the drum freely and settles 120ms after it goes quiet.

states.title: rest
states.description: The value is committed and announced as the wheel comes to rest. A unit beside the lens morphs with it, e.g. hour to hours. A dimmed option turns on to the nearest one that can be chosen.

states.title: set from outside
states.description: When the value changes from your code (a day that no longer exists in February), the wheel turns to it the shorter way round.
